title: Runtime error/logging and health signals are incomplete for incident diagnosis

original_titles.title: Structured JSON request logging absent: only startup/shutdown logs, none of the required fields

problem: The API unhandled_error_handler returns a generic error but does not log a structured traceback/request context. /health checks basic DB reachability but no dedicated readiness/metrics endpoint exposes worker heartbeat, queue lag, dead jobs, outbox backlog, pool pressure or scheduler status. External monitoring is absent.
impact: An event-day failure can be visible to participants but difficult for operators to diagnose. API uptime alone does not prove the worker or evaluator is healthy.

verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: Emit structured JSON logs with request_id, route, status, latency, principal id/role, error class and safe event scope. Redact credentials, tokens, report contents and GT data.
Add /readyz for database, required dependency and startup readiness checks; keep /health as a lightweight liveness endpoint.
Export metrics for request latency/error, DB pool wait, worker heartbeat, queue oldest age, retry/dead-letter count, outbox backlog, auto-submit lag and rate-limit hits.
Add alert thresholds and an external uptime check/status page. Test that an API process can be alive while worker readiness is degraded.
Add a runbook mapping each alert to safe operator actions and escalation.

acceptance_criteria: Every unhandled 500 has a request-correlated structured log.
Readiness reports API, DB and worker status independently.
An intentionally stopped worker triggers an alert while API liveness remains true.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.
